summary: Docebo Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an investor briefing presentation from its Inspire 2026 Conference. The filing contains a standard disclaimer, preliminary unaudited Q1 2026 ARR estimates, and forward-looking statements. There is no mention of any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. This is a routine foreign private issuer update providing an investor presentation with projected financial data and market commentary. No special-situation transaction or corporate event is disclosed.
